title: Factorial
description:
# Factorial

This program should read a non-negative integer `n` and print `n!` (n factorial), which is the product `1 × 2 × … × n`. By definition `0! = 1`.

This program has **more than one** bug. Find and fix them all so the tests pass.

## Input

A single integer `n` (`0 ≤ n ≤ 12`).

## Output

The value of `n!`.

```
Input:
5

Output:
120
```
starterCode:
n = int(input())
result = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1)
    result *= i
print(result)
